summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K containing two UK Regulatory News Service announcements detailing ongoing share repurchases under a buyback program announced July 21, 2026, with up to £405 million (~$540 million) authorized. Through July 31, 2026, the company repurchased Class A ordinary shares on Nasdaq, the London Stock Exchange, and Chi-X via Goldman Sachs International as broker. Repurchased shares are held in treasury, reducing outstanding share count and returning capital to shareholders. The buyback is being executed under the UK Market Abuse Regulation and FCA Listing Rule 14.3.17. Watch for continued daily transaction disclosures and tracking progress toward the program cap.
